summary: Backend validation for ZapPedidos tracker API. All 12 requested behaviors verified through 17 assertions against the public URL. Auth (JWT), RBAC (admin vs store), tenant isolation, order lifecycle (create -> dispatch), public tracker (auth-less, whatsapp-stripped), motoboy live location, and LAD config all pass.
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates store user + store_id, returns JWT
GET /api/auth/me returns current user with bearer token
GET /api/admin/stats -> 403 for store user, 200 for admin
POST /api/motoboys scoped to caller store; GET lists only own
Tenant isolation: store B does NOT see store A motoboys or order (404)
POST /api/orders returns pending status with tracking_token and motoboy_share_token
GET /api/track/{token} (no auth) returns order+store+motoboy WITHOUT customer_whatsapp
